task.title: Filter corpus samples by attempt presence
task.objective: Select records by structural attempt-list presence without inspecting attempt outcomes, diagnostics, patches, or text
acceptance_criteria: True matches a non-empty attempts list
False matches an empty attempts list
One or multiple attempts have the same presence state
The predicate composes conjunctively before applying the limit

attempts.summary: Added coverage for empty, single, and multiple attempts plus composition and failure semantics
attempts.diagnostic: Clap rejected the unimplemented has-attempts option

attempts.summary: Added strict boolean parsing and direct structural attempt-list matching
Applied the formatting correction found during independent review and reran the full gate
attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found formatting that did not match the repository gate

outcome.summary: Sampling can distinguish records with execution-attempt evidence from valid records without attempts

lessons: Structural list presence avoids coupling selection to the meaning of individual entries
Formatting findings are blocking when the repository quality gate enforces them
